message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limits page | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• No “seat‑belt law” for teens 16‑17, but they must wear a seat belt if the driver does. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | TxDOT – Mobile Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• No passing on the right unless the left lane is occupied or the vehicle is turning left. | TxDOT – Lane‑Changing Rules | | **School Bus** | • Stop 20 ft. from the bus when it’s stopped with its red lights flashing.
• Do not pass the bus until the lights are off and the stop sign is retracted. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft. of a crosswalk, 10 ft. of a stop sign, or 15 ft. of a fire hydrant.
• Parking on a shoulder is allowed only if the vehicle is stopped. | TxDOT – Parking Regulations | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red = stop, green = go, yellow = caution.
• Stop signs are mandatory; yield signs are advisory. | TxDOT – Traffic Signal Guide | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) – Vehicle Registration | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Department of Insurance – Auto Insurance | | **Special Rules** | • “No‑stop” zones: no stopping, standing, or parking.
• “No‑passing” zones: no overtaking.
• “No‑turn” zones: no left or right turns. | TxDOT – Roadway Signage | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Transportation Code** – The official legal text for all traffic laws. - **TxDOT website** – Offers updates on road conditions, construction, and new regulations. - **Texas DMV** – Provides information on licensing, registration, and insurance requirements. - **Local County Courts** – For specific traffic citations or legal advice. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. 2. **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement and saves lives. 3. **Avoid distractions** – especially handheld phone use. 4. **Respect school bus rules** – they’re designed to protect children. 5. **Check your mirrors before changing lanes** – Texas law requires it. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or have a particular scenario in mind, let me know!
